title: Canonical fixed-scalar pullback and purity-presentation comparisons
statement: Fix the finite-coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions] and scalar quotient functor with target action [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data]. Use the specified intrinsic pullback and source comparison maps [def-pur-finite-reduction-comparisons], the scalar-unit-normalized realization comparison [def-sp-finite-scalar-realization-presentations] [def-sp-coefficient-scalar-representatives], the canonical binary reduction [def-pur-finite-signed-reduction-comparisons], and the actual positive line reduction [def-pur-finite-root-tensor-presentation]. Transport the recorded pullback comparison through the realization equivalences, their units and the specified scalar presentation to obtain Q(f_A^*K) isomorphic to f_B^*(QK). Similarly transport the recorded shifted pullback source comparison. Define the purity target comparison independently as inverse binary tensor reduction followed by the transported pullback comparison tensored with the actual positive line reduction. Supply the published tensor-pullback map [def-pur-composition-comparisons] at the actual finite coefficient ring, providing its finiteness internally. All coordinate changes are these specified unit composites, with no independent arbitrary isomorphism.
